description_expanded: Located directly on the North Turtle Bale pedestrian path, this beautiful and impressive home is a welcome addition to the Alys Beach Rental program. Guests will enjoy four comfortable bedrooms, all with private baths. The first level features a dramatic two-story living room that is spacious with plenty of seating. The 1st floor bedroom offers four bunk beds (2 up, 2 down) with a private bath, just off the living room. The kitchen and dining areas offer plenty of room to gather and seating for ten. Guests will find one more bedroom with a king-sized bed on this level. The home also offers plenty of outdoor space. A private courtyard at the back of the home offers seating next to a fountain and access to a built-in grill. A wetbar with a separate icemaker and two refrigerated drawers supports the grill area for entertaining. The main courtyard with a private pool offers additional covered outdoor seating. Climbing to the second level, guests will find a pleasant sitting area overlooking the main living room. A bedroom with one king-sized bed, the laundry room, as well as the primary suite are found on this level. An expansive balcony runs most of the length of the home to a comfortable outdoor terrace with plenty of outdoor seating. Parking for this home is located in two designated spaces in a parking court behind the home. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
